name: Qwen Pose/Position Edit (instruction)
description: Edit an existing image from a plain-English instruction — change a subject's pose, position, or what they're doing while holding their identity, clothing, the room, and lighting. Powered by Qwen-Image-Edit-2511; the source image is the reference (no LoRA).

image.description: Source image filename or Studio output path to edit

prompt.description: Plain-English edit instruction. Describe only what changes; the model keeps everything else. Name each body part and where it goes ('left hand on her left hip'). Place the subject against named objects with an exact position ('on the path, one step left of the bench, not touching it'). 'Next to the bench' is too loose and can put the subject in front of the bench instead.
